name: Strengthening Mobility and Promoting Regional Integration of Engineering Education in Africa
deadline_notes: The University of Nairobi listing (undated) says only 'various dates depending on programme selected'. No dated call was found.
eligible_nationalities: Intra-Africa scheme rule: nationals of an African country who reside in Africa. A SPREE-specific list was not found.
notes: spreeafrica.com no longer resolves (DNS failure), so the project may have ended. Per University of Nairobi: 5 partners (East, Central, South, North, West Africa), with Ghent University (Belgium) as technical partner. Only 4 African partners are named; the Central African partner is unknown. Mobility types: Master degree-seeking at FUTA, UNZA and Moi; Master credit-seeking at Ain Shams; PhD degree-seeking at FUTA; staff mobility at all four. Moi University named Prof. Mwaisagi Igadwa as SPREE coordinator (Nov 2022 meeting), but the lead institution is not confirmed. No evidence of a 2026/27 call. Cities are the universities' main campuses.
